prompt.text:
Implement the following API.

File contract: Return solution.rs with the public function at module scope.
Required API: pub fn left_cycle(input: &str) -> Option<String>
Behavior: Parse canonical k;values where k is an unsigned decimal in 0..1000000 and values is a non-empty comma-separated list of canonical signed integers in -1000..1000. Rotate the list left by k modulo its length and return comma-separated values. Reject malformed or out-of-range input.
Visible example: 7;10,20,30 returns 20,30,10.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.

reference.code: fn nums(s:&str)->Option<Vec<i32>>{if s.is_empty(){return None}let mut o=vec![];for z in s.split(','){let x:i32=z.parse().ok()?;if x.to_string()!=z||x< -1000||x>1000{return None}o.push(x)}Some(o)}fn join(a:&[i32])->String{a.iter().map(|x|x.to_string()).collect::<Vec<_>>().join(",")}pub fn left_cycle(s:&str)->Option<String>{let p:Vec<_>=s.split(';').collect();if p.len()!=2||!p[0].bytes().all(|x|x.is_ascii_digit())||p[0].len()>1&&p[0].starts_with('0'){return None}let k:usize=p[0].parse().ok()?;if k>1000000{return None}let mut a=nums(p[1])?;let n=k%a.len();a.rotate_left(n);Some(join(&a))}
